parameters.responseBody:
={{ {
  ok: $json.ok === true,
  reason: ($json.reason || "").toString(),
  mode: ($json.mode || "").toString(),
  detail: ($json.detail || "").toString().slice(0, 400),
  pdf_bytes_est: Number($json.pdf_bytes_est || 0),
  tenant_id: ($json.tenant_id || "").toString(),
  order_id: $json.order_id ?? null,
  source: ($json.source || "").toString(),
  sent_to: ($json.sent_to || "").toString(),
  secret_used: ($json.secret_used || "").toString()
} }}
